svg.title: Hairdresser — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as hairdresser, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Open hair-cutting scissors have two clear finger loops beside a separate four-tooth comb. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: short hair, an oval face and round glasses.
